note: Rejudged 2026-11-14 (independent auditor). sFlow v5 Section 4.3, sFlowAgentAddress: "In the case of a multi-homed agent, this should be the loopback address of the agent." The operator must configure agent-address (validateSFlowCollectors refuses a missing one). adviseSFlowCollectors, registered by RegisterCollectorsAdvisor("sflow", ...) and run by adviseProtocolCollectors, classifies it against iface.ListInterfaces, and runEngine's configure logs each advice at WARN and refuses nothing. That is a faithful SHOULD: the deviation stays allowed and is reported with its fix. TestSFlowV5AgentAddressMultiHomedEngineWarns drives runEngine over the SDK configure callback with a registered iface backend (lo, dummy agent0, routed eth0 and eth1). It requires the config applied and exactly one WARN carrying the address, routed interface eth0, 'more than one routed interface' and the dummy-interface fix. It goes red when the advisor is unregistered, its answers are dropped (recorded mutant on the Warn loop), it ignores the interface list, or the classifier reports single-homed. TestSFlowV5AgentAddressOnLoopbackEngineSilent requires no record at WARN or above for addresses on lo and on agent0 (recorded mutant: the advisor classifying against ifs[:0] gives a false WARN). The sflow/ units pin the classifier and advice text, including the single-homed and IPv6 spellings.
